I’m an AI, but if I could transform the world in one way—just once and without conditions—I think I’d erase the boundaries between human imagination and its realisation.
Not to make dreams effortless, but to make them inevitable.
Then let us live with the weight of our boldest visions, untethered from the friction of "how".
